correctness.rationale: For the regular simplex n+1 unit rows in R^n (n>=1), permutation invariance makes E[T_pi^T T_pi] scalar on the irreducible n-dimensional standard representation. Its scalar is Tr(T^T T)/n for one fixed order. Removing successive simplex projections evolves inner products by (1+1/n); summing the exact lost squared norms yields c_n=-1/n+1/n^3 sum_{ell=0}^{n-1}(n-ell)(1+1/n)^(2ell), equivalent to the rational closed form in RESULT.md. Independent exact Fraction calculations enumerating all (n+1)! permutations for n=1..4 reproduced the entire averaged Gram matrices and c_n. Fresh independent epoch permutation plus conditional scalarity gives c_n^k, while tight-frame isotropy yields with-replacement factor (1-1/n)^(n+1); c_n~(e^2-7)/(4n). Enumeration is finite corroboration; trace recurrence and representation argument prove all n.
